texts.author: Traditional Okinawan song; notation and phonetic text by Lrschneider (2017)
texts.changes: First verse only. Added editorial kanji, word spacing, an original plain-Japanese explanation and vocabulary notes. This adapted verse, readings and explanations are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Readings use the score's chimisachi variant; variants in region and teacher's singing are expected. Practice alignment maps the large-symbol simplified sheet to phrase entrances at beats 16, 24, 32 and 40, with prelude beats 0–15 and outro from beat 45. One cell is one beat at the existing 85 BPM MIDI tempo. This is a practice alignment, not a transcription of a teacher recording; ornamentation and sung phrasing may differ. Added alignment metadata is also CC BY-SA 4.0. v22 rechecked the source image and places 26 phonetic fragments beside their large-symbol cells. The final ri belongs to beat 44, so singing continues through that beat and the outro begins at 45. Small ornamental syllables share their simplified main cell; the rest at beat 29 does not shift labels. Fragments and their placement retain CC BY-SA 4.0.
